title:
Comment of Kelsey in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/20/2026

documents.name: 151732.txt
documents.text:
Kelsey, Shoreline, WA.
I am commenting to express my extreme concern—as a voting, tax-paying citizen of the United States—that we are even considering this initiative. 

I am commenting to publicly express that I DO NOT CONDONE a deep sea data center in Maine. This land, this water, belongs to the people and the animals that were here long before AI—and it deserves to be that way. We the people DO NOT WANT data centers destroying our environment and rich resources to the benefit of millionaires and corporations who have little care or regulation in regards to how these data centers are managed. 

WE DO NOT WANT THIS. TO NOT ALLOW THIS TO PASS. NO TO DATA CENTERS. THE PUBLIC DOES NOT WANT THIS.
